# Jonathan Telep

> Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Cleveland, Ohio. Founder of Telep IO, a solo side studio. Builds and ships independent products on the open internet.

Jonathan Telep (Jon) is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat. Through [Telep IO](https://telep.io) — a side studio, not a full-time employer — he ships public products and does the same kind of work for other people. The latest live product is BarkMarks. The thing he is building toward is [telep.tools](https://telep.tools), the public tool shipyard.

Work with him via [jonathantelep.com/request](https://jonathantelep.com/request), [telep.io/contact](https://telep.io/contact) (studio), [jon@telep.io](mailto:jon@telep.io), or [@telep_io](https://x.com/telep_io) on X.

## Work and products

- [Telep IO](https://telep.io): studio founded by Jonathan Telep
- [unplayer](https://github.com/JonTelep/unplayer): watch any web video stream in mpv with no ads, popups or browser (open source CLI)
- [Bloomer](https://bloomer.news): positive AI news for bloomers; real breakthroughs, helpful tools, and milestones of AI history, each linked to its source (live)
- [StarterLoot](https://starterloot.com): free, curated library of AI tools for beginners starting game development (live)
- [jclip](https://github.com/JonTelep/jclip): clip a section of a YouTube or X video to mp4 or mp3 in one command (open source CLI)
- [oposse](https://github.com/Telep-IO/oposse): open source Omarchy plugin that puts Muse, ChatGPT Dots and Grok Bot behind one icon in the bar
- [ai-studio](https://github.com/JonTelep/ai-studio): open source AI video studio that turns a shot list into a finished MP4 (bring your own keys)
- [Local Library](https://github.com/JonTelep/local-library): ask questions answered from an offline Wikipedia by a local AI model
- [Let's Talk Statistics](https://letstalkstatistics.com): charts of official U.S. government statistics, each with its source (live)
- [minesSwept](https://minesswept.com): one minesweeper board, a million cells, everyone digs together. Built with Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects; real-time multiplayer over WebSockets ([source](https://github.com/JonTelep/mines-swept))
- [BarkMarks](https://bark.telep.io): know when the dog will bark — bark grades, timestamps, and streaming info for movies and TV (live)
- [sumvid](https://sumvid.app): video summarization — paste a link, get the point (live)
- [telep.tools](https://telep.tools): one home for every tool he makes (in progress)
- [Easy Data Quality](https://easydataquality.com): data quality checks (live)
- [seploy](https://github.com/Telep-IO/seploy): deploy utility from local to live (live)
- [skills](https://github.com/JonTelep/skills): agent skills that make Claude better at specific jobs (live)
- [omusey](https://github.com/Telep-IO/omusey): open source Omarchy plugin that puts Muse chat in the bar (live)
